test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 02 March 2023)
subject: reasoning
question:
Out of the following five figures, four are alike in some manner and one differs from these in that manner. Select the odd figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b4e427ef0b8c51b27e6bf43e29048b4031ba56ad45131d146a72e129ed31df61.png]
solution:
Logic : In each figure ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/501e3b200d73609544c9faff0ac161e7bcb63c5d67cb14dcf88ff9d60138a629.png] ' **part of the figure is in the opposite direction to the other one.** 

So,

 
• Option - (1) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/703b0abec8ab0a8975c41db551114ab6919992ee51bcf7346529370224f340b2.png] **⇒In the figure'** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/501e3b200d73609544c9faff0ac161e7bcb63c5d67cb14dcf88ff9d60138a629.png] ' part of the figure is not in the opposite direction to the other one i.e they are in the same direction.

• Option - (3) : 

⇒ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8a6aa873610196eea6764f63692dd2b0bd05a08ff88c9b64282d94f585d09481.png] ⇒In the figure ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/501e3b200d73609544c9faff0ac161e7bcb63c5d67cb14dcf88ff9d60138a629.png] ' part of the family is in the opposite direction to the other one.

 
• Option - (4) :

 ⇒ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2468a4cc1bea4b191d0c790b002e4300319469ef86304e82c65fb8c72a960f81.png] ⇒In the figure ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/501e3b200d73609544c9faff0ac161e7bcb63c5d67cb14dcf88ff9d60138a629.png] ' part of the family is in the opposite direction to the other one.
